description: This file manages filter state for an ag-grid table in a React application, including detecting the last modified filter input and converting filter models to SQL.

methods.name: detectLastFilteredInput
methods.description: Detects which filter input (first or second) was last modified based on the active element and filter instances.

methods.name: getCompleteFilterState
methods.description: Retrieves the current filter state, including SQL conversion and last input position, for the ag-grid table.
